name: audits
summary: Audits: a model reads the plate through one lens (security, tests, performance, size, correctness) when a provider's quota has room. `plates audit due` says which lenses are due and who has room, `brief` hands an agent the read-only brief, `record` checks its findings against the audited commit and writes docs/audits/<date>-<lens>.md; each finding is triage for the night. `run` previews then dispatches one lens through the owner's local host with --yes, returning a receipt without waiting or recording. Audits propose; they never build.
